title: Analytic: plane wave on an absorbing half-space, phasor fields (3D harmonic FDTD)
description:
A normally incident plane wave (+x, E along y) hits an absorbing half-space (eps_r = 2.25 plus sigma_e, eps'' = 1 at 1 um) in a 4 x 4 cell column, periodic along y and z, CPML along x (the absorber continues into the x_hi CPML). em_fdtd_3d in a frequency_domain study (harmonic FDTD): one gaussian pulse gives the phasor fields at the study wavelengths 0.8, 1.0 and 1.25 um and the flux spectra. The plane wave is one-sided (its box opens into the x_hi CPML), so the reflected plane (x = 0.2 um, before the box) sees only the reflection.
Analytic (exp(+j omega t), N = n - j kappa, eps = eps_r - j sigma_e / (omega eps0)): n, kappa = sqrt((|eps| +- eps_r) / 2); R = (1 + |eps| - 2 n) / (1 + |eps| + 2 n) (1 um: n = 1.535, kappa = 0.326, R = 0.0601); in front |E|^2 = 1 + R + 2 sqrt(R) cos(2 k0 (x - x_I) + phi_r), phi_r = atan2(2 kappa, 1 - |eps|); inside |E|^2 = 4 / ((1 + n)^2 + kappa^2) exp(-2 k0 kappa (x - x_I)); the transmitted flux at depth d is (1 - R) exp(-2 k0 kappa d) of the incident one (a single decaying wave carries no cross term).
Derived values tab: R_1000 and R_800 (-power_per_cw of the reflected plane / P_inc), T_depth (flux plane 0.25 um inside the absorber, 1 um).
Spectra tab: em.reflected power_per_cw vs the dashed -P_inc R(lambda) (R only varies 0.070-0.053 over the band, and curve errors are relative to that range: tolerance 0.1 = ~3 % of R).
Line profile tab (snapshot 'lambda = 1000 nm'): e_intensity_harmonic along x (scattered-field region |r|^2, standing wave, exponential decay) against the dashed curve.
Expected agreement: ~1 % in R (Yee interface and numerical dispersion, O((k dx)^2) at 10 nm cells), ~0.5 % in T_depth.

parameters.name: Lp
parameters.description: transverse period along y and z (4 cells)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length along x (cpml on both x faces)

parameters.name: x_I
parameters.description: front face of the absorber (a cell edge); it fills x >= x_I

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: upstream face of the plane-wave box (incident from here on)

parameters.name: d_depth
parameters.description: depth of the transmission flux plane inside the absorber

parameters.name: eps_abs
parameters.description: real relative permittivity of the absorber

parameters.name: lambda_b
parameters.description: second wavelength of the R check

parameters.name: sigma_abs
parameters.description: conductivity [S/m] giving eps'' = sigma / (omega eps0) = 1 at lambda0 (1.668e4 S/m)

parameters.name: sig_lam
parameters.description: eps'' per m of vacuum wavelength: eps''(lambda) = sig_lam lambda

parameters.name: bw
parameters.description: relative bandwidth of the pulse (covers 0.8-1.25 um)

parameters.name: P_inc
parameters.description: incident cw power [W] through one period: A^2 Ly Lz / (2 eta0)

parameters.name: band_stop
parameters.description: longest monitored wavelength (46 points, 10 nm apart)

analytic_curves.name: R_spectrum
analytic_curves.expression: -P_inc*(1 + hypot(eps_abs, sig_lam*wavelength) - 2*sqrt((hypot(eps_abs, sig_lam*wavelength) + eps_abs)/2))/(1 + hypot(eps_abs, sig_lam*wavelength) + 2*sqrt((hypot(eps_abs, sig_lam*wavelength) + eps_abs)/2))

analytic_curves.name: intensity_1000
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < x_src, R_0, where(x < x_I, 1 + R_0 + 2*sqrt(R_0)*cos(2*k_vac*(x - x_I) + phi_r0), Tin_0*exp(-2*k_vac*kap_0*(x - x_I))))
